# Chromatic aberration

Shifts red and blue (or a whole spectrum) apart, like a lens that focuses each wavelength at a slightly different place.

<EffectDemo effect="chromatic-aberration" />

## Usage

```ts
import { EffectComposer } from '@mk7s/xtree/core';
import { chromaticAberration } from '@mk7s/xtree/effects/chromatic-aberration';

const composer = new EffectComposer(renderer);
composer.setScene(scene, camera);
composer.add(chromaticAberration({ preset: 'subtle' }));
renderer.setAnimationLoop(() => composer.render());
```

Every parameter is also a property: `effect.offset = 0.004`. Uniform changes take effect on the next frame without recompiling; parameters marked _structural_ recompile the pass that contains the effect.

## Parameters

| Parameter                | Type                      | Default      | Range    | Description                                                                                        |
| ------------------------ | ------------------------- | ------------ | -------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `offset`                 | number                    | `0.004`      | 0 – 0.05 | Channel separation at the frame edge, as a fraction of the frame height.                           |
| `mode`                   | 'radial' \| 'directional' | `'radial'`   |          | Radial grows from the center like a real lens; directional shifts everything the same way.         |
| `falloff`                | number                    | `1`          | 0 – 3    | Radial mode: how quickly the separation grows toward the edges (0 is uniform).                     |
| `center`                 | [x, y]                    | `[0.5, 0.5]` | 0 – 1    | Radial mode: the optical center in UV coordinates.                                                 |
| `direction`              | [x, y]                    | `[1, 0]`     | -1 – 1   | Directional mode: the shift direction.                                                             |
| `samples` _(structural)_ | integer                   | `3`          | 3 – 16   | 3 shifts red and blue only; more samples blend a smooth spectrum (and cost one texture read each). |

Every effect also has `blend` (any of the 26 [blend modes](/reference/shaders#modes)), `opacity` (0–1) and `enabled`.

## Presets

| Preset    | Settings                                                       |
| --------- | -------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `subtle`  | `offset: 0.002`                                                |
| `lens`    | `offset: 0.008`, `falloff: 1.6`, `samples: 8`                  |
| `prism`   | `offset: 0.02`, `falloff: 1.2`, `samples: 12`                  |
| `shifted` | `mode: 'directional'`, `offset: 0.006`, `direction: [1, 0.25]` |

Apply one with `chromaticAberration({ preset: 'name' })` or `effect.applyPreset('name')`; presets start from the defaults.

## Details

- **Family:** Lens & camera · tracked as story X4.1 in the [plan](https://github.com/s4njee/xtree/blob/main/plan.md).
- **Passes:** samples the pass input at other positions, so it starts a new merged pass; following pixel effects join that pass.
- **Masks:** set `effect.mask` to a texture, depth range or selection to limit where it applies; see [masks](/guide/masks).
- **Motion:** Static: nothing animates.
- **Size:** 5.3 KB gzip budget for `@mk7s/xtree/effects/chromatic-aberration`, including the shared effect runtime.
